home.title: Global Lawyers Forum | Justice Without Borders
home.description: Global Lawyers Forum (GLF) is a federation of legal professionals across the UK, USA, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Canada, Turkey, the EU and the UAE, united to advance the rule of law and carry justice without borders.

mission.title: Our Charter | Global Lawyers Forum
mission.description: The charter behind Global Lawyers Forum: uphold the rule of law, enable cross-border practice, champion human rights, and advance professional excellence.

founder.title: Founding President | Global Lawyers Forum
founder.description: A message from Barrister Muhammad Sohail Anjum, Founder and First President of the Global Lawyers Forum.

chapters.title: Chapters | Global Lawyers Forum
chapters.description: The eight founding chapters of Global Lawyers Forum: United Kingdom, United States, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Canada, Turkey, the European Union and the UAE.

leadership.title: Leadership & Governance | Global Lawyers Forum
leadership.description: How Global Lawyers Forum is governed: the Presidency, the Bench of chapter presidents, and the Council of Benchers.

events.title: Events & Summits | Global Lawyers Forum
events.description: Upcoming Global Lawyers Forum convenings, including the Global Legal Summit and regional roundtables.

membership.title: Membership | Global Lawyers Forum
membership.description: Apply for membership with Global Lawyers Forum, or contact the Office of the Registrar. Associate, Fellow and Institutional tiers available.
